reviews.comment: Prof is young and presents the content very well. Exams allow one sheet of notes and there were weekly homework assignments. The content was to the point and as long as you study for exams and stay up to date with participation assignments for participation points, you were good.

Sam is a super nice dude and a great professor. The tests can be challenging if you don't go to class and review the material, but if you do it should be pretty straightforward. Sam also let us out early probably every day and was very receptive to any questions. Overall, great prof and super nice guy, I 100% recommend.

Sam is such a cool guy. I had him for an 8am and would not go to class, but would cram a lot for the exams. The exams were pretty straightforward, but it is harder if you do not go to class or do not pay attention to the slides. Overall Sam is a good lecturer and very easy to listen to. Would take him again in a heartbeat.

First and foremost, this is a graduate student teaching a Statistics class. Although he has a great personality, I personally do not like how he teaches his lectures. The homework assignments were not that difficult, but the exams were. Overall, I personally would not take this class again.

The course itself is very easy. The exams are straightforward and allow cheat sheets, plus there is tons of help available outside of lectures. However, the lectures could be quite boring. You don't have to attend the lectures to do well, but the notes did not always make sense without the lecture.

This was a very laid-back class. Tons of help was offered in the form of recitation and TA office hours and there was plenty of practice in class and before exams. The tests were fair and cheat sheets are allowed! I had a good experience, especially as someone who never took Stats in high school and was apprehensive coming in. Solid choice!

Sam is a very interesting, smart prof, he is very logical and there is no pressure to attend his classes. You just need to do your homework and study hard before the test to get an A is not a problem. He is very understanding to students, probably because he is still a graduate student, so don't hesitate if you have any questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things
